source: private cached rasters of the sealed N1v source packages (A01, Marcowki, Rarytasy G2E, Cieszynianki) read locally; no download, no OCR, no publisher pixel in the repository; OWNER ZIP not available
method: opening read as an object against the wall it is cut in: the plan's solid stretches of the same wall give the wall's per-row colour on the registered elevation; rows where most of the opening's columns match no stretch belong to the opening; slats/transoms bridged (0.3 m); the run must be closed above by wall (0.1 m lintel) and stays under the wall top (storey, eaves, gable rake); sill within 0.15 m of the floor snaps to the floor. Used only for gaps without a printed callout, and only where the contrast reader read nothing or a part of the same opening.

reused.N4 wall-band registration: adopted for opening reading only (bandOnly views); roof, rooflights, chimneys and wall finish keep to silhouette-registered views; a band-only view is accepted per wall only where >= 2/3 of the plan's gaps (at least 2) read on it as openings
reused.N3 light glazing symbol: adopted only for gaps whose heights an elevation read; the assumed-heights branch and the garage-mouth test keep the base glazing test (with its original span) unchanged
reused.N3 GLAZED_DOOR by symbol (assumed height: rejected: changed Gozdzikowce and Cieszynianki door kinds without a height read
